name: Martyr of Love
source:
It's the story of a 30 year-old man and his reminiscences. While he reflects on significant events, he has to make important decisions. It's up to you if he stays a martyr or finally leaves his past (self) behind.

[From [url=https://aliencat69.itch.io/martyr-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个30岁男人和他的回忆的故事。当他反思重大事件时，他必须做出重要决定。他是继续当烈士还是最终将过去（自己）抛在脑后，这取决于你。

[来自[url=https://aliencat69.itch.io/martyr-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
